snippet.title: SubDuctis - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself.

SubDuctis is a puzzle game that explores "space folding". Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and reach new areas by utilizing devices that collapse the world around you.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182310/SubDuctis/
